title: C. Scott Morse
description: Explains C. Scott Morse: "Chewbacca was once rescued from Imperial slavery by Han Solo. Here, Chewie is seen repaying his Wookiee life-debt by saving his comrade from certain doom." While studying animation at the California Institute of the Arts, Morse has also managed to co-create, illustrate, and self-publish the comic book series ANCIENT SIEGE. His upcoming comics work includes a creator-owned limited series, entitled SOULWIND, for Larry Stroman and Todd Johnson's new breakthrough company, Axis Comics.
